in the windows s in [1/2,2] x [T0-1,T0+1], T0 in {14,20,30,40}, with N = M_0(T0)-1 and theta0 = theta(T0): the Dirichlet polynomial d_N(s) = sum_{n<=N} n^{-s} has zeros with Re s > 1/2, while J_N(p; theta0) (p = s - 1/2) has none off the line Re p = 0.

predictions.companion_check: identity (9) of PROSHKA_JN_ZERO_FREE_STRIP_ATTEMPT_2026-09-17: J_N(p;theta) = B(p) d_N(s) + E_N(p;theta), checked numerically at 20 random strip points to 30 digits (no prediction registered: an identity is PASS/FAIL)
predictions.mac_note_before_run: zero counts by winding number of d_N on the s-rectangle boundary and of J_N on the p-rectangle [-3/2,3/2] x [T0-1,T0+1] (symmetric, (4)), on-line zeros of the real function J_N(i tau) counted separately by sign changes; off-line count = total - on-line. Partial sums d_N with N >= 19 are known to have zeros with Re s > 1 (Montgomery), so MAC expects d_N zeros in the windows for T0 >= 20 at least; for J_N MAC expects zero off-line count, consistent with the adaptive discriminator table.

method_notes.fixed_N_flip: scan T0..T0+40 step 0.05, sigma {1/64,1/8}, mpmath dps 50; arb ball at the first negative point and at the last positive point before it; zero count by winding number (phase unwrapping, step control < pi/2) on rectangles [0.01, 1/2] x [T0+10k, T0+10(k+1)] and mirrors [-1/2, -0.01] x ...; the sigma offset 0.01 is needed because J_{N0}(iT) is real and its on-line zeros lie on the sigma=0 side (irreducible phase jumps of pi); zeros with 0 < Re p < 0.01 are therefore not counted.
method_notes.head_masses: mpmath dps 50 on the adaptive-cutoff zeta grid (1120 points) and the DH control strip (1161 points); arb at 10 points (5 zero heights sigma=1/64, T in {14,20,30,40,60} sigma=1/4) for the sign of M_+ - M_- - E_N, regression against L_N of grid_arb_dps80_adaptive.json
